correctness.rationale: For \(a,b>0\) and \(\tau\ge0\), \(M\) is positive definite and \(K\) is positive semidefinite. The displayed denominator factors are all positive. Direct symbolic multiplication verifies \(A_\tau P_\tau=M\); all diagonal and adjacent entries have positive numerators for \(\tau>0\), and the opposite-node entries are exactly \(6\tau q(\tau)/D_\tau\). Since \(q(0)<0\), \(q'(\tau)>0\), and \(q\) has one positive root, the claimed iff threshold follows. At \(\tau=0\), \(P_\tau=I\).
